visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a black textured plate holding steak and spaghetti. A small, curly green herb (parsley) is positioned on top of the pasta. The lighting is bright and even. (2) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white short-sleeved blouse, is seated at a restaurant table. She holds a fork with the green herb, looking at it with a contemplative expression. Behind her, the restaurant has red accents and soft indoor lighting. (3) A young man with short dark hair in a light yellow collared shirt appears. He scratches his head while holding a fork with the herb, appearing confused. The background shows a modern restaurant interior with tables and other diners. (4) A montage sequence shows a woman's hand holding the herb out to various diners. People of various ages are seen laughing, thinking, and gesturing. One young man with glasses looks intently at the herb. The scene shifts between different tables within the same bright restaurant environment. (5) The camera returns to the first young woman. She takes a bite of the herb. Her facial expression shifts from curiosity to a grimace of distaste, squinting her eyes and wrinkling her nose. Yellow variety-show style text overlays the screen during her reaction.
